debates.question: 幸福到底是什么？我们是否应该追求幸福？
debates.question_en: What is happiness, really? And should we even pursue it?

debates.question: AI 时代，人如何夺回注意力与存在的意义？
debates.question_en: In the age of AI, how do we reclaim our attention and the meaning of our existence?

debates.question: AI 取代人类工作后，会有『存在危机』吗？
debates.question_en: After AI replaces human work, will we face an 'existential crisis'?
debates.sub: 普通人又该怎样面对大面积的中年失业？
debates.sub_en: And how should ordinary people cope with mass midlife unemployment?

debates.question: 原生家庭的创伤，能真正走出来吗？
debates.question_en: Can we truly move past the trauma of the family we're born into?
debates.sub: 我们多大程度被童年塑造？又是否有希望改变父母？
debates.sub_en: How much does childhood shape us — and is there any hope of changing our parents?

debates.question: AI 与算法：在增强我们，还是在让我们退化？
debates.question_en: AI and algorithms: are they augmenting us, or making us atrophy?

debates.question: AI 时代该怎么养孩子？——拼命鸡娃、挤名校到底还值不值得？
debates.question_en: Raising kids in the age of AI: is intense 'tiger parenting' and chasing elite schools still worth it?

debates.question: 科技大厂的『扁平化』——一个经理带 30–50 人，会成为常态吗？
debates.question_en: Big-tech 'flattening' — one manager over 30–50 reports: is this the new normal?

debates.question: 是否有“造物主”，如果有的话，TA为什么要造出人类？
debates.question_en: Is there a 'Creator'? And if so, why would they have made humankind?

debates.question: 一个好的『管理者』，到底是怎样的？
debates.question_en: What actually makes a good manager?

debates.question: 『知道』和『做到』之间，差在哪？
debates.question_en: Where does the gap between knowing and doing come from?
debates.sub: 知道该锻炼、该早睡，却很难做到——这道缝隙从何而来？
debates.sub_en: We know we should exercise and sleep early — yet rarely do.

debates.question: 人是否应该追求长生，如果人真的能够长生，世界会怎样？
debates.question_en: Should we pursue immortality — and if humans really could live forever, what would the world become?

debates.question: 我们该如何面对死亡？如何做到「向死而生」？
debates.question_en: How should we face death — and how do we actually live 'toward' it (being-toward-death)?

debates.question: 金钱能（在多大程度上）买到幸福？
debates.question_en: Can money buy happiness — and how much?

debates.question: 「只专注你能控制的」，是智慧还是逃避？
debates.question_en: 'Focus only on what you can control' — wisdom, or escape?
debates.sub: 它会不会成了对改不了的不公视而不见的特权式借口？
debates.sub_en: Does it become a privileged way of looking past injustice you could help change?

debates.question: 年轻人为什么不想生孩子了？
debates.question_en: Why don't young people want children anymore?
debates.sub: 尤其在亚洲——这对个人与社会又意味着什么？
debates.sub_en: Especially in Asia — and what does it mean for the individual and for society?

debates.question: 为什么这一代人越来越难谈恋爱？
debates.question_en: Why is this generation finding it ever harder to date?
debates.sub: 走入亲密关系变难，是个人问题，还是时代造的？
debates.sub_en: Is the trouble forming intimate relationships a personal failing, or one the age has made?

debates.question: 儒、释、道的异同：三家分歧究竟在哪，又在何处殊途同归？
debates.question_en: Confucianism, Buddhism, and Daoism: where do the three traditions truly differ, and where do they converge?

debates.question: 普通人投资，该买大盘指数，还是买自己拿着放心的个股？
debates.question_en: For ordinary investors: buy the broad index, or the individual stocks you can hold with confidence?

debates.question: 靠恐惧驱动的优秀，该不该放下？
debates.question_en: Should we let go of excellence driven by fear?
debates.sub: 『要够好才配被爱』——放下了，会不会连动力也一起没了？
debates.sub_en: 'I must be good enough to deserve love' — and if we let go, do we lose the drive too?

debates.question: 东方与西方哲学，源头何以不同？
debates.question_en: Why did Eastern and Western philosophy diverge at the source?
debates.sub: 它如何塑造了今天的东西方人？两边的智慧又能否融合？
debates.sub_en: How did that shape the people we are today — and can the two wisdoms be fused?

debates.question: 『组织政治』是毒瘤，还是必需？
debates.question_en: Is 'office politics' a tumor, or a necessity?
debates.sub: 大型组织里的政治，普通人该如何看待、甚至善用它？
debates.sub_en: How should ordinary people view — even make good use of — politics in large organizations?

debates.question: 家中老人病重、靠插管维持近乎植物人的状态，作为子女，该不该撤管放手？
debates.question_en: When an elderly parent is critically ill and kept in a near-vegetative state by life support, should the children withdraw it and let go?

debates.question: 企业用人，该「以德为先」还是「以才为先」？
debates.question_en: When a company hires and promotes, should it put character first, or ability first?

debates.question: 下属不行，该带教还是该换人？
debates.question_en: When a subordinate falls short: coach, or move them out?
debates.sub: 能力或动力不足时，领导该花时间 coaching，还是果断 manage out？
debates.sub_en: If ability or motivation is lacking, should a leader invest time in coaching or decisively manage them out?

debates.question: 「你眼中的别人，其实是你自己」？
debates.question_en: 'The others you see are really you' — is that true?
debates.sub: 『你眼中的别人不是别人，你眼中的自己不是自己，你眼中的别人才是自己』——这话有道理吗？
debates.sub_en: 'The others you see aren't really them, the self you see isn't really you, and the others you see are actually you.'

debates.question: 父母年迈失能，该亲自接回家照顾，还是送养老院、请护工？
debates.question_en: When parents grow old and frail, should you care for them at home yourself, or place them in a nursing home and hire professional carers?

debates.question: 世俗意义上的『成功』——财富、地位、名声、成就——到底值不值得追求？
debates.question_en: Is worldly 'success' — wealth, status, fame, achievement — worth pursuing at all?

debates.question: 「忠于真实的自我」是不是个伪命题？到底有没有一个本真的我？
debates.question_en: Is 'being true to your authentic self' a false premise — and is there even an authentic self to begin with?

debates.question: 什么样的不平等是可以接受的？
debates.question_en: What kind of inequality is acceptable?

debates.question: 我们的成功与失败，多少是「应得的」？努力真能决定命运吗？
debates.question_en: How much of our success or failure do we actually deserve — and does effort really decide our fate?

debates.question: 该不该用基因编辑「设计」更聪明、更健康的下一代？
debates.question_en: Should we use gene editing to 'design' smarter, healthier children?

debates.question: 该频繁跳槽，还是在一处深耕固守？
debates.question_en: Should you job-hop often, or stay put and dig deep in one place?

debates.question: 生产力一次次飞跃，人更闲了还是更忙了？
debates.question_en: With each leap in productivity, are we more leisured or busier?
debates.sub: 农业、工业、AI 三次革命——人是更幸福，还是更不幸？
debates.sub_en: Across the agricultural, industrial and AI revolutions — happier, or unhappier?

debates.question: 一样东西的价值，到底由什么决定？（劳动、效用、稀缺，还是别的？）
debates.question_en: What ultimately determines the value of a thing? (Labor, utility, scarcity — or something else?)

debates.question: AI 创造的财富，会让社会更不平等吗？
debates.question_en: Will the wealth AI creates make society more unequal?
debates.sub: 是赢家通吃的马太效应，还是反而造就更公平的社会？
debates.sub_en: A winner-takes-all Matthew effect, or a fairer society instead?

debates.question: 想改变自己，该先立身份还是先放下自我？
debates.question_en: To change yourself: build an identity first, or let the self go?
debates.sub: 成功学说『先改 identity』、贴正向标签；佛学说看破我执、无我——哪一条走得通？
debates.sub_en: Self-help says claim a positive label and reinforce a new identity; Buddhism says see through self-grasping. Which one works?

debates.question: 人是否拥有真正的自由意志？
debates.question_en: Do we have genuine free will?

debates.question: 是地理塑造了思想，还是思想自有其命？
debates.question_en: Did geography shape thought, or do ideas have a life of their own?
debates.sub: 东西方为何不同——是地理与物质环境决定，还是偶然、伟人与观念的力量？
debates.sub_en: Why East and West differ — geography and material conditions, or contingency, great individuals and the force of ideas?

debates.question: 想活得不后悔，该入世还是出世？
debates.question_en: To live without regret: engage the world, or withdraw from it?
debates.sub: 投身事功与人群，还是超脱放下、向内求安？
debates.sub_en: Throw yourself into achievement and people, or transcend, let go and seek peace within?

debates.question: 为什么我们忍不住跟别人比？嫉妒能消除吗？
debates.question_en: Why can't we stop comparing ourselves to others? Can envy ever be eliminated?

debates.question: 如果有了足够的钱（财务自由），是否还应该继续工作？
debates.question_en: If you had enough money to never need to, should you still work?

debates.question: 量子物理是否说明「观测」真的改变了世界？
debates.question_en: Does quantum physics show that 'observation' really changes the world?

debates.question: AI 时代，人的心智该往「深」练还是往「广」练？
debates.question_en: In the AI era, should the mind train for depth or for breadth?

debates.question: 品德是教出来的，还是长出来的？——美德到底可不可教？
debates.question_en: Can virtue be taught — is character instilled, or does it grow on its own?

debates.question: 普通人该进大厂求稳，还是闯小公司、创业？
debates.question_en: Should ordinary people play it safe at a big company, or take the leap into a startup?

debates.question: 贫富差距本身会让人生病吗？该不该把不平等当成一个公共健康问题？
debates.question_en: Does the wealth gap itself make people sick — and should inequality be treated as a public-health issue?

debates.question: 教育到底是为了什么——筛选人才的机器，还是培养人的土壤？
debates.question_en: What is education for — a machine to sort talent, or soil to cultivate a person?

debates.question: AI 时代，该练流体智力还是晶体智力？
debates.question_en: In the age of AI: train fluid intelligence, or crystallized?
debates.sub: 临场推理，还是深厚积累——抑或真正稀缺的是坐在两者之上的判断力？
debates.sub_en: On-the-spot reasoning or deep accumulation — or is the real scarcity the judgment that sits above both?

debates.question: 数学是被发现的，还是被发明的？
debates.question_en: Is mathematics discovered, or invented?

debates.question: 进步是真的吗？历史是在前进，还是循环、甚至退步？
debates.question_en: Is progress real? Is history moving forward, in cycles — or even backward?

debates.question: 现代的『文明进步』，是解放还是控制？
debates.question_en: Modern 'civilizational progress': liberation, or control?
debates.sub: 废酷刑、办学校、建医院、讲人道——是人的解放，还是一种更高效、更彻底的控制？
debates.sub_en: Abolishing torture, building schools and hospitals, preaching humanity — the liberation of humankind, or a more efficient and total control?

debates.question: 容颜该顺其自然地老去，还是该努力医美、抗衰？
debates.question_en: Should we let our looks age naturally, or fight it with cosmetic work and anti-aging?

debates.question: AI 有没有、或可能有意识？我们又凭什么判断？
debates.question_en: Does (or could) AI have consciousness — and how would we ever know?

debates.question: 语言塑造思维吗？说不同语言的人，看到的是不同的世界吗？
debates.question_en: Does language shape thought? Do speakers of different languages see different worlds?

debates.question: 美，是主观感受，还是有客观的标准？
debates.question_en: Is beauty just in the eye of the beholder, or is there an objective standard?

debates.question: 我们为何系统性地低估『照护与情感劳动』的价值？
debates.question_en: Why do we systematically undervalue care and emotional labor?

debates.question: 绩效考核与「赛马」（KPI、末位淘汰）是激励，还是毒药？
debates.question_en: Performance appraisal and stack-ranking (KPIs, rank-and-yank): motivation or poison?

debates.question: 我们对远方陌生人的苦难，负有多大义务？
debates.question_en: How much do we owe to the suffering of distant strangers?

debates.question: 拖延症，到底要不要治？
debates.question_en: Should we cure procrastination at all?
debates.sub: deadline 是第一生产力，重要的事最后也赶得出来——那它究竟是不是病？
debates.sub_en: Deadlines are the ultimate productivity engine and the important things still get done — so is it really a disease?

debates.question: 全球化正在让世界失去文化多样性吗？
debates.question_en: Is globalization costing us cultural diversity?
debates.sub: 世界被磨成同一种模样——这是进步，还是一种贫乏？
debates.sub_en: The world ground into one shape — is that progress, or an impoverishment?

debates.question: 真爱是发现的，还是培养（甚至建构）出来的？
debates.question_en: Is true love found, or cultivated — even constructed?

debates.question: 公司到底该对谁负责——只对股东，还是也对员工与社会？
debates.question_en: Whom does a company answer to — only its shareholders, or also its workers and society?

debates.question: 人真的在逃避自由吗？——自由是解放，还是一副人宁愿卸下的重担？
debates.question_en: Do people really flee from freedom — is freedom a liberation, or a burden they would rather set down?

debates.question: 该主动过「极简 / 少欲」的生活吗？
debates.question_en: Should we deliberately live simply?
debates.sub: 梭罗式的『简化，再简化』是通往自由与清醒的智慧，还是一种特权、逃避、甚至另一种精致的消费主义？
debates.sub_en: Is Thoreau's 'simplify, simplify' a road to freedom and clarity — or a privilege, an escape, even a refined consumerism?

debates.question: 「社会兴趣」是衡量活得好不好的尺吗？
debates.question_en: Is 'social interest' the yardstick of a life well lived?
debates.sub: 阿德勒说它是心理健康与幸福的关键——那独处、自我实现、离经叛道，是病还是另一种活法？
debates.sub_en: Adler called it the key to mental health and happiness — so are solitude, self-realization and nonconformity a sickness, or another way to live?

debates.question: 濒死体验证明意识能脱离大脑吗？
debates.question_en: Do near-death experiences prove consciousness can leave the brain?
debates.sub: 是灵魂离体的证据，还是垂死大脑的最后一场烟花？
debates.sub_en: Evidence of a soul departing the body, or the dying brain's last fireworks?

debates.question: 时间真的存在吗，还是一种幻觉？
debates.question_en: Does time really exist, or is it an illusion?
debates.sub: 钟表在走、人在变老，可物理学里找不到一个普适的『现在』——流逝是世界的性质，还是心造的？
debates.sub_en: Clocks tick and we grow old, yet physics finds no universal 'now' — is the flow a property of the world, or something the mind makes?

debates.question: 我们对地球（其他物种、后代）负有怎样的义务？
debates.question_en: What do we owe the Earth — other species, and future generations?

debates.question: 我们是不是正在失去『第三空间』？
debates.question_en: Are we losing our 'third places'?
debates.sub: 闲逛式的日常社交在消失——孤独流行病从何而来？
debates.sub_en: Aimless everyday sociability is vanishing — where does the loneliness epidemic come from?

debates.question: 该不该让算法来管人——派活、打分、监控，甚至解雇？
debates.question_en: Should algorithms manage people — assigning the work, scoring it, watching it, even ending it?

debates.question: 维系和谐，有时是否比说出真相更重要？
debates.question_en: Is keeping the peace sometimes more important than telling the truth?

debates.question: 宇宙真的是「黑暗森林」吗？文明之间注定你死我活，还是可能合作？
debates.question_en: Is the universe really a 'dark forest'? Are civilisations doomed to destroy one another, or can they cooperate?

debates.question: 该不该用 AI「复活」逝去的亲人？
debates.question_en: Should you use AI to 'resurrect' a dead loved one?
debates.sub: 用聊天记录与声音训练一个『TA』来陪伴自己。
debates.sub_en: Training a 'them' from their messages and voice to keep you company.

debates.question: 自由与平等不可兼得时，该牺牲哪个？
debates.question_en: When liberty and equality cannot both be had, which gives way?
debates.sub: 累进税、遗产税、学区名额、平台抽成——每一次让弱者好过些都要动用强制；每一次守住『我的就是我的』，差距就再拉开一寸。
debates.sub_en: Progressive taxes, estate duties, school catchments, platform commissions — every arrangement that eases life for the weak invokes coercion; every defence of 'what is mine is mine' widens the gap.

debates.question: 当 AI 比谁都懂，领导者还剩什么不可替代的？
debates.question_en: When AI knows more than anyone, what is left that only a leader can do?

debates.question: 爱一个人，该介入他的人生多深？
debates.question_en: How far should love intervene in another's life?
debates.sub: 『不干涉他人因果』是尊重与智慧，还是给冷漠找的灵性借口？哪怕对家人？
debates.sub_en: Is 'don't interfere with another's karma' respect and wisdom, or a spiritual excuse for indifference — even with family?

debates.question: 该为过去的选择后悔吗？
debates.question_en: Should we regret the choices we made?
debates.sub: 「如果当初…」反复啃噬——面对不能重来的过去，该放下、该担起，还是根本没有那条没走的路？
debates.sub_en: The 'if only I had…' that keeps gnawing: with a past you cannot redo, do you let it go, take it on, or find there was never a road not taken?

debates.question: 真的存在平行宇宙吗？
debates.question_en: Do parallel universes really exist?
debates.sub: 多世界诠释与永恒暴胀都推出无数个「你」——一个永远观测不到的理论，还算科学吗？
debates.sub_en: The many-worlds reading and eternal inflation both yield innumerable copies of you — but is a theory that can never be observed still science?

debates.question: 有什么是金钱不该买卖的？
debates.question_en: Is there anything money should not be able to buy?
debates.sub: 从代孕、器官到选票与照护——当市场逻辑渗进一切，还有没有该守住的非卖品？
debates.sub_en: From surrogacy and organs to votes and care: as market logic seeps into everything, is anything still off the auction block?

debates.question: 职场该不该表达野心？
debates.question_en: Should you show your ambition at work?
debates.sub: 同样一份野心，有人叫领导力，有人被判「太有攻击性」——谦逊这条规范，究竟服务了谁？
debates.sub_en: The same ambition reads as leadership in one person and as "too aggressive" in another — so whom does the modesty norm actually serve?

debates.question: 园丁还是木匠？父母该塑造孩子吗？
debates.question_en: Gardener or carpenter: should parents shape a child?
debates.sub: 按蓝图雕琢，还是养好土壤等花自己开——以及早早贴上的「优秀」标签，后来把人带去了哪。
debates.sub_en: Carve to a blueprint, or tend the soil and wait for a bloom nobody can predict — and where an early label of “gifted” actually leads.

debates.question: 真正的『勇气』是什么？
debates.question_en: What is courage, really?
debates.sub: 是无所畏惧，还是带着恐惧仍然前行？它能不能像肌肉一样练出来？
debates.sub_en: The absence of fear, or moving forward while afraid — and can it be trained like a muscle?

debates.question: 世界是唯物的，还是唯心的？
debates.question_en: Is the world made of matter, or of mind?
debates.sub: 意识只是大脑放的电，还是比物质更根本的实在？
debates.sub_en: Is consciousness just the brain's electricity, or something more fundamental than matter?

debates.question: 物质极度丰裕后，人会走向衰亡吗？
debates.question_en: Does material abundance lead to decline?
debates.sub: 卡尔霍恩的鼠群在无限食物里走向崩溃——匮乏是意义的必要燃料吗？
debates.sub_en: Calhoun's mice collapsed amid unlimited food — is scarcity a necessary fuel for meaning?

debates.question: AI 做完入门的活，新人怎么学本事？
debates.question_en: If AI does the entry-level work, how do novices learn?
debates.sub: 学徒、实习、蹲着调 bug——那些『笨办法』该刻意保留，还是该让它去？
debates.sub_en: Apprenticeships, internships, sitting with a bug — keep the slow way on purpose, or let it go?

debates.question: 忠诚该不该被考验？
debates.question_en: Should loyalty be put to the test?
debates.sub: 一段只有在不被验证时才成立的信任，算不算真的信任？
debates.sub_en: If a trust only holds while nobody verifies it, is it trust at all?

debates.question: 钱该省下来滚复利，还是该花掉？
debates.question_en: Should money be saved to compound, or spent?
debates.sub: 为将来的自己牺牲现在的自己，能牺牲到什么程度？
debates.sub_en: How much of your present self should be spent on your future self?

debates.question: AI 能伪造一切，我们还信什么？
debates.question_en: When AI can fake anything, what is left to trust?
debates.sub: 『眼见为实』失效之后，信任还能建在什么上面
debates.sub_en: After seeing-is-believing fails, what can trust still be built on

debates.question: 社会该不该允许安乐死与协助死亡？
debates.question_en: Should society allow euthanasia and assisted dying?
debates.sub: 当病痛已无可挽回、本人清醒地请求结束时
debates.sub_en: When the illness is past repair and the person, lucid, asks for it to end

debates.question: 只有一条晋升阶梯的组织，浪费了谁？
debates.question_en: Who is wasted by an organisation with only one ladder?
debates.sub: 把「不想升」读成缺乏进取心，是组织在系统性浪费人，还是个人本该接受阶梯的规则？
debates.sub_en: When "not wanting the promotion" is read as lack of drive — is the organisation wasting people systematically, or should individuals simply accept the ladder’s rules?

debates.question: 趁年轻，该搏事业还是先去看世界？
debates.question_en: When young: build a career, or go see the world first?
debates.sub: 阅历与事业，错过的那一个还补得回来吗？
debates.sub_en: Experience or a career — can whichever you skip ever be recovered?
